Actions.Name: PAINEL GOALS
Actions.Tooltip: Open Goal selection, creation, execution output and logs

Actions.Name: EXECUTAR / PAUSAR
Actions.Tooltip: Run or resume the selected Goal through Codex CLI, or pause its execution. Choose and confirm it in PAINEL GOALS first.

Actions.Name: TROCA AUTOMÁTICA
Actions.Tooltip: Automatically rotate JEY, AMERICANO and HB according to confirmed capacity; wait if all are exhausted.

Actions.Name: CODEX JEY
Actions.Tooltip: Switch active Codex account to JEY

Actions.Name: CODEX AMERICANO
Actions.Tooltip: Switch active Codex account to AMERICANO

Actions.Name: ABRIR NO CELULAR
Actions.Tooltip: Start or stop Codex Status on your phone

Actions.Name: USAR HB
Actions.Tooltip: Switch to HB; sign in through PAINEL GOALS first
